data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €793
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterhafen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 21 May 2026. It results in a refund of €793.00 after withheld wage tax of €5,195.00 is credited against tax of €4,402.00.
data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment for 2025. Tax was set at €4,402.00, but your employer already withheld €5,195.00, so you get €793.00 back. The refund should be paid to your known bank account in the next few days. If you think anything is wrong, for example missing deductions, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically, or record it at the office. The app shows until when you can do this. Check the figures against your tax return. A tax adviser can help if unsure.

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids

items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Musterhafen, Kaistraße 1, 27568 Musterhafen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with Finanzamt Musterhafen, or declare it in person at the office.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final and can normally no longer be challenged.

items.title: Receive tax refund
items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
items.action: Check that the refund arrives in your bank account.
